name: _actions.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  star-field/_actions.scss — the bottom-right action cluster (screenshot /
//  overview buttons) and the shared sf-btn control style — the project's
//  corner-bracket button signature (expands to a full frame on hover),
//  themed by the --sf-* chrome vars on :host.
//  Imported by star-field.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

.#{$_B_SF}-actions {
  position: absolute;
  // Inside the framed viewport — one pad up/in from the canvas edges.
  bottom: calc(#{to-rem($space-xl)} + #{to-rem($space-md)});
  right: calc(#{to-rem($gap-272)} + #{to-rem($space-md)});
  z-index: 30;
  display: flex;
  gap: to-rem($space-sm);

  // Track the site's content gutter at every grid step — mirrors %MAXAREA
  // plus the inner pad that clears the viewport frame.
  @include grid-steps() using ($step, $gap, $cols) {
    right: calc(#{to-rem($gap)} + #{to-rem($space-md)});
  }
}

// Corner-bracket button — the same chrome .home-mosaic-btn uses: mono
// uppercase label inside expanding corner brackets, themed ink so the
// glass reads in light and dark mode.
.#{$_B_SF}-btn {
  @extend %RESETBTN;
  @extend %TTL_XS;

  font-weight: 400;
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  text-align: center;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-lg);
  color: var(--sf-ink);
  background: var(--sf-chrome-2);
  backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
  cursor: pointer;

  &::before,
  &::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: to-rem($space-sm);
    height: to-rem($space-sm);
    transition:
      width 0.25s ease,
      height 0.25s ease;
  }

  &::before {
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    border-top: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-ink-2);
    border-left: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-ink-2);
  }

  &::after {
    bottom: 0;
    right: 0;
    border-bottom: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-ink-2);
    border-right: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-ink-2);
  }

  &:hover,
  &:focus-visible {
    opacity: 0.75;

    &::before,
    &::after {
      width: calc(100% - to-rem($space-2xs));
      height: calc(100% - to-rem($space-2xs));
    }
  }
}

// Mobile-only instructions button and modal hidden by default on desktop.
.#{$_B_SF}-instructions-btn {
  display: none;
}

.#{$_B_SF}-instructions-modal {
  display: none;
}
